verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is itself a documented programmatic framework: Python and Node.js SDKs let code join rooms as realtime participants. A hands-on probe confirmed the pip and npm packages install and import without a key. The evidence never shows a documented public API (REST or server API reference) for driving the product itself, such as dispatching agents, managing deployments or controlling rooms, so only the SDK side of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented REST/server API reference for controlling agents, rooms and deployments; API reference depth (endpoints, auth model); independent corroboration of driving the product programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Agents framework lets you add any Python or Node.js program to LiveKit rooms as full realtime participants.
You can use it to deploy any code that needs to process realtime media and data streams as a programmatic participant.
pypi livekit-agents 1.8.0 installs and `import livekit.agents` succeeds with no key
